meta.name: writing-skills
meta.description: Use when creating new skills, editing existing skills, or verifying skills work before deployment

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 创建、编辑和验证你的自定义技能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要创建或管理自定义技能
copy.tagline_en: Create, edit, and verify your custom skills
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to create or manage custom skills

howto.what: 装好后，Claude 会按照测试驱动开发的方式创建或编辑技能：先写测试场景观察失败，再写技能文档确保通过，最后修补漏洞。
howto.when: 当你要求创建新技能、编辑现有技能，或验证技能能否正常工作时触发。

say.text: 我想创建一个新技能，先设计一个测试场景。
say.note: Claude 会先模拟子代理测试，然后编写技能文档。

say.text: 帮我检查这个技能文档，看有没有漏洞。
say.note: Claude 会运行压力测试并指出需要修补的地方。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will apply test-driven development to create or edit skills: first write a test scenario, observe it fail, then write the skill document to make it pass, and finally refactor to close loopholes.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to create a new skill, edit an existing skill, or verify a skill works before deployment.

say_en.text: I want to create a new skill. Let's start with a test scenario.
say_en.note: Claude will simulate a subagent test, then write the skill document.

say_en.text: Check this skill document for loopholes.
say_en.note: Claude will run pressure scenarios and suggest fixes.
